description_ru: Современные отложения. Озерно-болотные отложения. Глины, суглинки, супеси, торф, прослои мелкозернистого песка
note: GGK-200 N-42-III (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR 1:200 000, 1st edition; Main Tyumen GU, authors A.I. Vlasov, M.F. Pikh, ed. S.B. Shatsky; approved 1975, printed 1977; 68-69E 55d20m-56dN). Titled 'geological map and map of mineral resources', but its legend lists only Quaternary units + undivided pre-Quaternary (the Quaternary map of the plain). RASTER = geokniga 2000x2384 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py); lakes = WATER; saIII (subaerial cover loams) and vIII (eolian cover) coded E (PI decision 2026-10-04) and merged (same printed yellow); pre-Quaternary rocks appear only on the sections; frame = 4 corners on the inner edge of the neatline + 9 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings + 12 graticule-at-frame ties; corners set by eye (the image is cropped at the outer border, which the corner tools took) (r200i)
